subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should this PR intentionally make previously accepted oversized, symlinked, or non-regular cron quarantine sidecars fail closed, with operator repair as the upgrade recovery contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof are complete, but green CI cannot decide whether blocking cron persistence on incompatible shipped state is the intended recovery policy.

options.title: Accept strict recovery contract
options.body: Approve the 8 MiB regular-file boundary and retain manual operator repair or reset for incompatible sidecars.

options.title: Add doctor repair first
options.body: Add a bounded doctor migration or reset path before enforcing the stricter runtime boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept strict recovery contract
recommendation.body: Approve the 8 MiB regular-file boundary and retain manual operator repair or reset for incompatible sidecars.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the final quarantine persistence implementation and is the strongest available owner for its recovery policy.
